args.title: Fix off-by-one error in paginate: end index included extra item
args.body:
## Summary
Fixed an off-by-one bug in `src/paginate.py` where the slice end index was calculated as `start + size + 1` instead of `start + size`, causing the last item of one page to bleed into the next page.

## Change
- `src/paginate.py`: Changed `end = start + size + 1` to `end = start + size`

## Test
`tests/test_paginate.py::test_page_size_is_exact` now passes.
